questions.text: What game did you finish exactly once and refuse to ever replay, and what was it that you didn't want to sit through again?

Which NPC lives rent-free in your head? Not a main character — a side character you still think about.

What's the best money you've spent in a game — the purchase you'd make again instantly?

What's the highest rank, score, or placement you've ever hit in anything competitive? Brag properly.
What game mechanic makes you close the game instantly? Escort missions, timed levels, fishing minigames — name it.
